title: Site differential activity, snATAC-seq in liver myofibroblasts, NASH vs. normal (Elison et al. 2024)
bodyHtml:
The plot and table display snATAC-seq site differential activity in liver myofibroblasts from individuals with non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) vs. individuals without NASH (Weston Elison et al., University of California San Diego, 2024, unpublished). This work was supported by the Foundation for the National Institutes of Health.

Only regions with adjusted p-value < 0.1 are shown here. Complete data are represented in the dataset DSR732FAC at the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
